sentences.text: Henry Condell -LRB- 5 September 1576 -LRB- baptised -RRB- -- December 1627 -RRB- was an actor in the King 's Men , the playing company for which William Shakespeare wrote .	baptised	Baptism	William Shakespeare	William Shakespeare
With John Heminges , he was instrumental in preparing and editing the First Folio , the collected plays of Shakespeare , published in 1623 .	John Heminges	John Heminges	First Folio	First Folio
Condell 's early life is obscure .
It appears that he may have been from East Anglia , as his will mentions ` my Cosen Gilder late of newe Buckenham ' .	East Anglia	East Anglia	newe Buckenham	New Buckenham
According to Edmond :

The only Henry Condell so far discovered at a suitable date in that part of England was the son of a Robert Condell of St Peter Mancroft , Norwich , a fishmonger , and his wife , Joan , née Yeomans , of New Buckenham , a market town not far from Norwich .
Henry Condell , presumably their son , was baptized at St Peter on 5 September 1576 .

Traditionally , he is associated with the `` Harry '' who appears in the cast list for Richard Tarlton 's The Seven Deadly Sins , but this identification is little more than conjecture .	Richard Tarlton	Richard Tarlton

If the connection is true , then Condell was an actor as early as 1590 , acting in Lord Strange 's Men alongside John Heminges and Augustine Phillips .	John Heminges	John Heminges	Augustine Phillips	Augustine Phillips

Condell was definitely in London by 24 October 1596 , when he married , at St Laurence Pountney , Elizabeth Smart -LRB- d. 1635 -RRB- , the only child of John Smart of the Strand , gentleman .	St Laurence Pountney	St Laurence Pountney	Strand	Strand, London
They settled in St Mary Aldermanbury , the parish in which Heminges lived .	St Mary Aldermanbury	St Mary Aldermanbury
Condell , like Heminges , served as churchwarden in that church .	churchwarden	churchwarden

Nine children were baptized there , born between 1599 and 1614 , of whom only three survived to adulthood : Elizabeth -LRB- baptized 26 October 1606 -RRB- , who married Herbert Finch ; Henry -LRB- baptized 6 May 1610 , died 1630 -RRB- ; and William -LRB- baptized 26 May 1611 -RRB- .
Details of Condell 's mature life , as is usual for Renaissance actors , are few .

His status within the Lord Chamberlain 's and King 's companies appears to have been high ; in official communications he is generally listed shortly after Burbage and Heminges .	Burbage	Richard Burbage
Actors ' wills indicate that he was close to at least some of his colleagues in the company .

Shakespeare and Phillips bequeathed him money for mourning rings ; Nicholas Tooley and Alexander Cooke named him as trustee for their estates .	Nicholas Tooley	Nicholas Tooley	Alexander Cooke	Alexander Cooke

Condell prospered enough in his profession to purchase a country home at Fulham in Middlesex and other property , including an estate called Brockhampton in Snowshill , Gloucestershire .	Fulham	Fulham	Middlesex	Middlesex	Snowshill	Snowshill	Gloucestershire	Gloucestershire
The indentures recording the latter purchase contain the only known example of Condell 's signature or handwriting apart from his last will .

In addition to Every Man in His Humour -LRB- 1598 -RRB- and Every Man Out of His Humour -LRB- 1599 -RRB- , Condell is known to have performed in four more of Jonson 's plays : Sejanus -LRB- 1603 -RRB- , Volpone -LRB- 1605 -RRB- , The Alchemist -LRB- 1610 -RRB- , and Catiline -LRB- 1611 -RRB- .	Every Man in His Humour	Every Man in His Humour	Every Man Out of His Humour	Every Man Out of His Humour	Sejanus	Sejanus (play)	Volpone	Volpone	The Alchemist	The Alchemist (play)	Catiline	Catiline: His Conspiracy
He was the original Cardinal in John Webster 's The Duchess of Malfi -LRB- c. 1613 -RRB- .	John Webster	John Webster	The Duchess of Malfi	The Duchess of Malfi

And he was listed in eight of the cast lists that were added to the second Beaumont and Fletcher folio of 1679 :	second Beaumont and Fletcher folio	Beaumont and Fletcher folios	1679	1679 in literature
Bonduca	Bonduca	Bonduca
The Captain	The Captain	The Captain (play)
The Humorous Lieutenant	The Humorous Lieutenant	The Humorous Lieutenant
The Knight of Malta	The Knight of Malta	The Knight of Malta
The Loyal Subject	The Loyal Subject	The Loyal Subject
The Mad Lover	The Mad Lover	The Mad Lover
The Queen of Corinth	The Queen of Corinth	The Queen of Corinth
Valentinian	Valentinian	Valentinian (play)
Condell appears to have ended his stage career around 1619 .
He signed each of the nine sheets of his last will and testament on 13 December 1627 .
He died at Fulham aged 51 , and was buried at St Mary Aldermanbury on 29 December 1627 .	St Mary Aldermanbury	St Mary Aldermanbury	Fulham	Fulham
His widow , Elizabeth , was buried there on 3 October 1635 .
Condell left an extensive estate , including shares in the Globe and Blackfriars Theatres .	Globe	Globe Theatre
